caller.order: Copies old service state, constructs and assigns fresh defaults from 0x140d47ae0, calls service+8 virtual slot +0x18 to populate an 8-byte value at stack+0x38, then calls 0x140d56db0(state=service+0x10, section=service+0x1d8, value=&stack+0x38). Subsequent virtual configuration passes occur after discovery.
caller.default_fields: Constructor 0x140d47ae0 initializes state+0 byte to 1, state+8 environment string empty, state+0x38 Protocol to http, state+0x48 Domain to <unconfigured>, state+0x58 BasePath and state+0x68 ServiceName empty, and state+0x78 EngineName to UE4. The strings are copied from runtime literals 0x145b23e50, 0x145b0da80 and 0x145b23e60 respectively.

discovery.provider_accessor: 0x140d4cdc0 returns the shared provider slot at 0x1480dfb10. The code tests the 32-bit count at slot+8, the pointer at slot+0, and provider virtual slot +0x28 returning nonzero, in that order. If any test fails, it returns without selecting an environment or modifying state.
discovery.enabled_path: Calls 0x140d58600(state) first. It then makes an owned copy of the FString at state+8 (length at state+0x10) and calls the discovery provider virtual slot +0x48 with arguments (provider, section, pointer to the copied environment FString, pointer to the caller-provided 8-byte value, state). It frees the temporary string after the call. Thus the provider receives mutable state and may populate it, but this wrapper itself directly changes only state+8 through the selector. The copied environment is the pre-provider selection; exact provider writes are not established.
discovery.provider_stability: The provider slot is fetched again before slot +0x48; the code assumes a provider remains present after the enabled check. The runtime image stores a heap pointer in that slot, outside this mapped image. The identity and implementation of this provider have not been recovered from this evidence.

environment_selection.distinct_provider: Uses a separate shared slot returned by 0x140d4cd50, not the discovery slot returned by 0x140d4cdc0. If its count, pointer and virtual +0x28 enabled check succeed, calls its virtual +0x48 and moves the returned FString into state+8, then returns, even if the returned string is empty.
environment_selection.fallback: Otherwise parses command line EPICAPP= into state+8; if FString length is <=1, tries EPICENV=; if still <=1, tries MCPCONFIG=. The fallback is entered only inside the enabled discovery-provider path when invoked through this hook. Selector does not run at all when the discovery provider is absent or disabled.

implementation_boundary: Implement the observed no-provider path by leaving fresh defaults for the following configuration passes; do not unconditionally select command-line environment at this hook. The enabled-provider path requires the provider implementation and registration, including what fields it mutates and its own sources. Its precise behavior and final deployed endpoint cannot be inferred from the call signature. Do not substitute an endpoint or claim full discovery closure.
validation: Read-only Capstone instruction decoding of bounded hook, caller, provider accessors, environment selector and default constructor from the pinned runtime image; direct bounded UTF-16 literal reads. No native edits, build, tests, live endpoint or runtime compatibility claim.
